notes.title: Prepare to save your webcam career in WebCum Secrets 🔞💦!
notes.content:
[h3]This Saturday, get ready for our new game where you'll try to save the career of Frank, a webcam model manager. 

Collaborate with rising model, try to build and save your relationships, face betrayal and find support among your friends and partners. This industry is just like any business - you'll face struggles, unfair play from your opponents, challenges to overcome and important decisions to make. 

[u]Mark your calendars and wishlist the game so you won't miss a little bonus we've prepared for you![/u]

With stunning 3D visuals and easy, one-handed controls, every choice you make will impact the outcome - see if you can help Frank turn his fortunes around![/h3]
